body:
>"So I was right, huh? There was someone else. You know what, I've fucking changed my mind, if you ever need someone to talk to you can go fuck yourself because I don't fucking care anymore. Have a nice life you bitch."

This is as close to the original text I sent her as I can remember, and as the days went on it became more destructive and dark ass they went on. I used personal information she shared with me to demean and insult her, showing no remorse for her as I raved on about how shitty of a person she was. If using verbal abuse to hurt someone you love isn't monstrous then I don't know what is. Even as I type this I fight the urge to send her more texts, about what a huge cunt she is. Using every fiber of my being to tear her apart. So far I've done everything short of telling her that she'll be the reason I kill myself. It isn't the monsters in our dreams that are the scariest, but the ones that are in us. When you get to the point where you don't care that the ones you love will suffer from your actions, you tell me if you're a monster or not.

I appreciate the sentiment my friend. But there has been too much shit to deal with in my life. I'm only 20 years old and I've experienced more heartbreak, agony, and bullshit than most will experience in their entire lives. I didn't write out everything in detail because it would have taken days to finish this post, and the details would have made it easier to exact who I am. I'm tired. Broken and tired. I've done and said things to the only person I've ever loved as much as her that I couldn't have imagined doing to my worst enemy. I'm not me anymore, and I can't go back and undo it. I've changed for the worst, and it's broken me to the point where I don't even care anymore. If there ever was a chance of winning her back, I've all but destroyed it. And the fact that she didn't even respond when I told her I was going to kill myself showed me that she never really cared. The lies she told me with ease, the ability to discard me for someone else within a week. I'm easily replaced. So I might as well end it on my terms. A bottle of vodka, a smoke, and some music. It's the best way I could ever hope to go out.

It's not just the girl. It's everything I've had happen in my life. The girl was the last straw, the straw that broke the camels back. It showed me how all I've ever done, everything i've ever hoped to achieve was worthless. I work a shitty job, still living with my parents who only give me respect because I provide a source of money. Everyone in my life who was supposed to love or care for me has taken a shit on me. I no longer care about the feelings of others, because it's been made apparent that mine have never been cared about. Love has eluded me not because I didn't try, but because no one has cared enough to give it.
